name: Matsunaga Tsukasa
source: A young man with amnesia. He's a sociable, kind, and warmhearted person. He resembles the young man who took care of Souta and the others when they were children, and he comes to be called by that person's name. He's optimistic about his own situation and always brightens his surroundings.
